about.title: About Punarjiva Organics
about.intro: Created by health-conscious minds, Punarjiva Organics is dedicated to reviving the body's natural harmony through organic foods, nature-led care and time-tested Ayurvedic wisdom.

sections.heading: What “Punarjivam” means to us
sections.body: The body deserves Punarjivam — a revival powered by organic purity and ancient natural strength. That idea shapes what we stock: staples that belong in a traditional Indian kitchen, personal care that stays close to its plant sources, and Ayurvedic preparations that have been trusted for generations.

sections.heading: Our promise
sections.body: Organic purity, ancient strength, true Punarjivam. We offer verified, hygienic products for everyday wellness, rooted in traditional practices.

sections.heading: What we bring together
sections.body:
- **Rasayana & Vitality** — classical tonics such as Chyawanprash, lehyams and ashwagandha.
- **Herbal Churna & Kadha** — triphala, moringa, turmeric and tulsi-giloy.
- **Skin & Hair Care** — plant-led care for twak and kesha.
- **Abhyanga & Healing Oils** — bhringraj, groundnut and coconut oils.
- **Ahara: the Ayurvedic Pantry** — millets, dals, atta, spices, jaggery and honey.

sections.heading: A store you can take your time in
sections.body: Step into a space crafted to feel serene, grounded and close to nature. Explore, ask and choose at your own pace — and if you would rather send your list ahead, WhatsApp works just as well.
